name: Rui de Araújo
role: Portuguese factor and captive; later interpreter of charges
bio: While captive, Araújo needs intermediaries to get news and correspondence out. After the conquest he appears on the other side of the fortress audience.
notes: fact: Araújo sent intelligence while captive; Birch has him read the charges when Utimutiraja and others are arrested (1511-events.md §1; Birch III, pp. 147–148)
gameplay: The routes used by repeatable courier errands are invented, not a record of his actual letter carriers (people-factions.md §§1, 4)
